transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um, I came in because I just feel wound up almost all the time. It's like... my body is constantly bracing for the next bad thing to happen. It doesn't even really matter what I'm doing. I could just be sitting at my desk at work, or trying to go out and enjoy a dance night, and I still have this constant tension. It's just really starting to get to me, so I figured I should talk to someone.
Do you find yourself worrying about a number of different things, like work, relationships, health, or other everyday matters, even when there isn’t a clear reason to be concerned?

Yeah, I definitely do. It used to just be about my condo, but my worry doesn't really stay on that anymore. It just jumps around all over the place. Like, I'll worry about whether my cousin is upset with me, or if I'm going to make a mistake on a support call at work. And then it shifts to other things, like how I'll ever save money or just... move forward with my life in general. It's just a lot of different things all the time, even when nothing is actually going wrong.
Do you ever notice physical symptoms like muscle tension, trouble sleeping, or restlessness along with this constant worry?

Yeah, the sleep thing is a big issue for me. Most nights, I'll get into bed just completely exhausted, but... my brain just won't shut off. It keeps replaying all these things, like loan notices, or open work tickets, or just stuff I might have missed during the day. It'll go on like that until 2 or 3 in the morning. And then, even when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I barely rested at all.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or lack energy almost every day, even if you haven't done anything particularly strenuous?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean, I'm definitely tired in the mornings because I don't sleep well, but... once I actually get up and start my day, my energy is usually fine. I don't really feel drained or exhausted all day long.
Have you noticed yourself becoming more irritable or easily annoyed lately, even over small things?

No, not really. I mean... I definitely get stressed out with all the worrying, but I don't think it makes me irritable. I don't really find myself snapping at people or getting annoyed over little things, no.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you’re not good enough, even when things aren’t necessarily your fault?

No, I wouldn't say that. I worry a lot about getting things right at work, making sure I don't miss anything important, but... I don't really sit around feeling guilty or down on myself. It's more just the stress of trying to keep up with everything, not really a feeling of being worthless or anything like that.
